events.title: Trailer Expedition Update 0.6
events.summary: On Friday, October 23, 2026, the massive Expedition Update 0.6 will be released. The demo will receive an update that will be over 20 GB in size.In this trailer, you can get a brief overview of everything there is to discover.Patch notes will follow on the day of release.

events.title: Version 0.6 is well on its way
events.summary: A Look Ahead to UPDATE 0.6It will still be a little while before the next update arrives. events.title: Demo 0.5 - Patch 4
events.summary: - Docking positions are now always assigned to the correct station. events.title: Demo 0.5 - Patch 3
events.summary: - The autopilot now reliably observes the intended speed limit in the Outer Ice Ring.- Scroll lists for ship colors, notepad colors, and ship appearances now retain their position.- Tau Ceti attack charges now accumulate both online and offline up to the upgraded storage limit.- Flight Point bonuses now correctly apply to every player-controlled ship and are calculated from its equipped stats.- Cargo optimization now uses the ship’s actual equipped cargo capacity.- Fixed asteroids in the asteroi

events.title: Demo 0.5 - Patch 2
events.summary: Moving black screen areas in asteroid regions have been fixed. Background effects now remain correctly visible at all times.The current objective now retains your mining progress after materials are stored or sold.Refinery and Factory completion notifications now disappear automatically when the corresponding building is opened directly.Active missions now display the combined total requirements for all required resources.Mining chances for the current area are now displayed in the HUD.
